abilities.name: Angler's Luck
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to catch a magic carp instead of your usual catch
abilities.summary: You can catch a Magic Carp in place of your usual catch.

abilities.name: At Any Cost
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain 10% more experience by sacrificing an additional arrow.
abilities.summary: Can spend one extra arrow for 10% more experience.

abilities.name: Baker
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to double experience from cooking bread
abilities.summary: Baking bread can award double XP.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) when hit to gain Berserk: +12 strength and -4 attack for your next 4 swings.
abilities.summary: Taking a hit can grant +12 Strength and −4 Attack for your next four swings.

abilities.name: Bleeding Edge
abilities.description: Chance to gain double the experience from skilling activities, equal to $curr% ($min-$max) minus your double up chance.
abilities.summary: Skilling can award double XP. The chance is the ability’s power minus your double up chance.

abilities.name: Blood Ward
abilities.description: Upon casting a blood rune spell, $curr% ($min-$max) chance to take 5 damage and build up a protective ward that absorbs up to 30 damage and lasts 30s.
abilities.summary: Casting a Blood Rune spell can cost 5 HP and create a ward that absorbs up to 30 damage for 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Bloodscent
abilities.description: When swinging at a target below 25% HP, $curr% chance ($min-$max) to swing 3 times.
abilities.summary: A swing can hit three times against a target below 25% HP.

abilities.name: Bounty Hook
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to catch double the fish and gain double fishing experience
abilities.summary: A catch can award twice the fish and Fishing XP.

abilities.name: Burst of Strength
abilities.description: A prayer that increases your strength by 10. Consumes one spirit rune per attack.
abilities.summary: Adds 10 Strength. Uses one Spirit Rune on each melee attack.

abilities.name: Chaos Conduit
abilities.description: Upon casting a chaos rune spell, $curr% ($min-$max) chance to spend a mind rune instead of the chaos rune.
abilities.summary: Casting a spell that uses a Chaos Rune can spend a Mind Rune in its place.

abilities.name: Clarity of Thought
abilities.description: A prayer that increases your attack by 10. Consumes one spirit rune per attack.
abilities.summary: Adds 10 Attack. Uses one Spirit Rune on each melee attack.

abilities.name: Clumsy Flame
abilities.description: Lightly burns you once in a while.
abilities.summary: Scales occasionally deals a small amount of fire damage to its owner.

abilities.name: Coal Keeper
abilities.description: Chance to use one less coal per ore smelted or superheated. Your chance is ( 10 + Firemaking level + Ability level )%
abilities.summary: Smelting or superheating can use one fewer Coal Ore. The chance in percent is 10 + Firemaking level + ability level.

abilities.name: Conserve Air
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to save 2 air runes when casting spells or performing activities
abilities.summary: Casting spells or performing activities can save two Air Runes.

abilities.name: Conserve Fire
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to save 2 fire runes when casting spells or performing activities
abilities.summary: Casting spells or performing activities can save two Fire Runes.

abilities.name: Crusader
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) on swing to gain +100 strength for 24s.
abilities.summary: A swing can grant +100 Strength for 24 seconds.

abilities.name: Cursed Strength
abilities.description: Doubles your physical damage and delay with two handed weapons.
abilities.summary: Doubles both physical damage and the time between swings with a two-handed weapon.

abilities.name: Dark Twist
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max), when a spell would hit for 1, to deal your max hit instead.
abilities.summary: A spell roll of 1 damage can become a maximum-damage hit.

abilities.name: Death's Bargain
abilities.description: Lets you perform the Dark Ritual at the Totem of Zem. $curr% ($min-$max) chance to not consume the cut diamond.
abilities.summary: Lets you perform the Dark Ritual at the Totem of Zem and gives you a chance to keep the Cut Diamond.

abilities.name: Dragon Rage
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) on a melee swing to spit a fireball at your target for up to 10 fire damage.
abilities.summary: A melee swing can launch a fireball that deals up to 10 fire damage.

abilities.name: Dread Aura
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to make your foe skip its attack.
abilities.summary: Can cause your enemy to skip an attack.

abilities.name: Drosswork
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to make a chunk of dross when forging an item
abilities.summary: Forging can create one piece of Dross.

abilities.name: Empowered Mind
abilities.description: Upon casting a mind rune spell, $curr% ($min-$max) chance to gain Empowered Mind for 22s: +2 Wind Strike and Fire Strike max damage.
abilities.summary: Casting a spell that uses a Mind Rune can raise the maximum damage of Wind Strike and Fire Strike by 2 for 22 seconds.

abilities.name: Enlightened
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) when hitting your max hit to double the experience gained.
abilities.summary: A maximum-damage hit can award double experience.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) on a melee swing to deal the damage above 10 as fire to all enemies within 20 paces and to yourself.
abilities.summary: A melee swing can apply the part of its damage above 10 as fire damage to you and all enemies within 20 paces.

abilities.name: Fanaticism
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) when obtaining a spirit rune while meleeing to gain Fanaticism, making your next two swings quick. Consumes a blood rune.
abilities.summary: Gaining a Spirit Rune in melee can speed up your next two swings. The effect uses a Blood Rune.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit fire damage. Casting requires five fire runes, three air runes, and a death rune.
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Bolt
abilities.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit fire damage. Casting requires four fire runes, two air runes, and a chaos rune.
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Strike
abilities.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit fire damage. Casting requires three fire runes and a mind rune.
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Wave
abilities.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit fire damage. Casting requires eight fire runes, five air runes, and a blood rune.
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals fire damage.

abilities.name: Flame Glutton
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to burn 2-8 logs at once, granting experience for each, but less ash
abilities.summary: A burn can consume 2–8 logs in one action. You get XP for each log and less ash.

abilities.name: Fletcher's Eye
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to double experience from fletching
abilities.summary: Fletching can award double XP.

abilities.name: Focus
abilities.description: Your spells cast slower but each one hits for 20% more damage.
abilities.summary: Spells take longer to cast and deal 20% more damage.

abilities.name: Forbidden Magic
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) for your spell to deal 50% more damage but also strike you for the full amount, though never enough to kill.
abilities.summary: A spell can deal 50% more damage. It also hits you for the full amount, up to the point that leaves you alive.

abilities.name: Gemcraft
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to triple experience from cutting gems
abilities.summary: Cutting gems can award triple XP.

abilities.name: Gilded Pockets
abilities.description: Increases loot bag capacity by 3.
abilities.summary: Adds three spaces to your loot bag.

abilities.name: Graced Aim
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to deal 2 damage instead of missing.
abilities.summary: A ranged miss can deal 2 damage instead.

abilities.name: Green Thumb
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to double the yield when picking grain or flax
abilities.summary: Harvesting grain or flax can produce twice the usual yield.

abilities.name: Igniting Shot
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to cast Fire Strike as you shoot. Requires appropriate runes.
abilities.summary: A shot can cast Fire Strike when you have the runes for it.

abilities.name: Ill Omen
abilities.description: Curses you when landing a spell for damage ending in 4, causing your next spell to hit for only 1 damage. $curr% ($min-$max) chance.
abilities.summary: Spell damage ending in 4 can curse you, causing your next spell to deal 1 damage.

abilities.name: Inner Furnace
abilities.description: Stores $curr% ($min-$max) of the fire damage you take (for 60s, refreshing) and unleashes it as a fireball at the next enemy to land a melee hit on you. Requires a shield equipped.
abilities.summary: With a shield equipped, stores a share of fire damage you take for 60 seconds. The next enemy to hit you in melee takes the stored damage as a fireball. Taking more fire damage refreshes the duration.

abilities.name: Iron Gut
abilities.description: Mining double ups have a $curr% chance ($min-$max) to build 2-6 hunger, stinging you for 1-3 damage. At 10 hunger, your next mining double up triggers twice and eats your equipped meat pie.
abilities.summary: A Mining double up can add 2–6 Hunger and deal 1–3 damage to you. At 10 Hunger, the next Mining double up triggers twice and consumes your equipped Meat Pie.

abilities.name: Lantern's Gift
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to also mine a piece of coal when mining any ore underground
abilities.summary: Mining ore underground can also yield Coal Ore.

abilities.name: Light Bite
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to keep your feather, shrimp or frog bait when fishing
abilities.summary: A fishing action can preserve the Feather, Raw Shrimp, or Raw Frog it uses as bait.

abilities.name: Mixed Earth
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) when mining copper or tin, to mine whichever one you have the least of
abilities.summary: Mining copper or tin can yield whichever of those two ores you have less of.

abilities.name: Molten Reflection
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to reflect fire spell damage back at the caster.
abilities.summary: Can send damage from a fire spell back to its caster.

abilities.name: Mudwright
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain 6 crafting experience when mining clay
abilities.summary: Mining clay can award 6 Crafting XP.

abilities.name: Paralyze Monster
abilities.description: A prayer with a 60% chance to make enemies skip their turn. Consumes a sacred rune per skipped attack.
abilities.summary: Has a 60% chance to skip an enemy attack. A skipped attack uses one Sacred Rune.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) of parrying enemy melee attacks while wielding any staff, or a two handed melee weapon.
abilities.summary: A staff or two-handed melee weapon can parry enemy melee attacks.

abilities.name: Patronage
abilities.description: Every two minutes, tosses 2-10 of your coins to another player in your zone.
abilities.summary: Every two minutes the cape gives another player in your zone 2–10 of your coins.

abilities.name: Penance
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain a spirit rune when taking 10 or more damage.
abilities.summary: Taking at least 10 damage can grant a Spirit Rune.

abilities.name: Plume Catcher
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to obtain a feather when fishing
abilities.summary: Fishing can yield an extra Feather.

abilities.name: Protector of Progryn
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) for your active prayers to also trigger on allies fighting the same monster.
abilities.summary: Your active prayers can also affect allies attacking the same enemy.

abilities.name: Pulverize Iron
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) of destroying the iron you just mined, gaining 50% more experience
abilities.summary: An Iron Ore you mine can be destroyed to award 50% more XP.

abilities.name: Pyreshell Ward
abilities.description: Reduces damage from dragon's fire breath by $curr% ($min-$max)
abilities.summary: Reduces incoming damage from dragon breath by a percentage that rises with ability level.

abilities.name: Quench
abilities.description: Consume a chunk of dross when forging an item of steel or better to gain a stack of Quenched, reducing the coal required to smelt that metal's bar by $curr% ($min-$max)
abilities.summary: Forging steel or better gear can use Dross for a Quenched stack. It reduces the coal needed to smelt a bar of that metal.

abilities.name: Quick Hex
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to cast your first spell quickly.
abilities.summary: Can speed up the first spell you cast.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to shoot again. Can trigger itself.
abilities.summary: Can fire an extra shot, and that shot can trigger Rapid Fire again.

abilities.name: Rapid Heal
abilities.description: A prayer that triples your health regeneration speed. Consumes one spirit rune per regeneration event.
abilities.summary: Triples health regeneration speed. Each regeneration event uses one Spirit Rune.

abilities.name: Ra's Splinter
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to find gold ore when cutting yew or magic trees.
abilities.summary: Chopping a yew or magic tree can yield Gold Ore.

abilities.name: Rubber Body
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) for an enemy swing to bounce off you.
abilities.summary: An enemy swing can bounce off you.

abilities.name: Sacred March
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain a spirit rune when dealing damage.
abilities.summary: Dealing damage can grant a Spirit Rune.

abilities.name: Sacred Strike
abilities.description: When using a progrite weapon, $curr% chance ($min-$max) to swing twice at demons.
abilities.summary: A Progrite weapon can swing twice against a demon.

abilities.name: Salt Cure
abilities.description: When cooking on a fire, 20% chance to burn food, but $curr% bonus cooking XP ($min-$max). Burning still grants XP.
abilities.summary: Cooking at a fire grants a level-dependent XP bonus and adds a 20% chance to burn the food. A burned action still awards XP.

abilities.name: Sanguine Harvest
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain a blood rune when slaying an enemy with more than 100 maximum HP.
abilities.summary: Killing an enemy with more than 100 maximum HP can grant a Blood Rune.

abilities.name: Scarab's Feast
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to steal 1 HP when swinging for more than 5 damage and the enemy is not at full health.
abilities.summary: A swing that deals more than 5 damage can steal 1 HP from a target that is below full health.

abilities.name: Scarab's Plea
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to heal 1 HP when taking 4 or more damage.
abilities.summary: Taking at least 4 damage can heal you for 1 HP.

abilities.name: Serpent's Return
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) for arrows to return to you when fighting from safe spots.
abilities.summary: Arrows can return to you when you fight from a safe spot.

abilities.name: Shell Pockets
abilities.description: Increases loot bag capacity by 2.
abilities.summary: Adds two spaces to your loot bag.

abilities.name: Shepherd
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to gain 6 crafting experience when shearing sheep
abilities.summary: Shearing sheep can award 6 Crafting XP.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to cap incoming damage to a maximum of 30% of your maximum HP with a shield equipped
abilities.summary: With a shield equipped, an incoming hit can be capped at 30% of your maximum HP.

abilities.name: Sniper
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to deal maximum damage if the enemy is at full HP.
abilities.summary: A shot can deal maximum damage when the target is at full health.

abilities.name: Soft Landing
abilities.description: Reduces fall damage by 75%.
abilities.summary: Cuts fall damage by 75%.

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.description: Upon killing an enemy with a death rune spell, $curr% ($min-$max) chance to gain your overkill damage as mind runes.
abilities.summary: Killing an enemy with a Death Rune spell can award one Mind Rune per point of overkill damage.

abilities.name: Sour Stomach
abilities.description: Woodcutting double ups have a $curr% chance ($min-$max) to build 2-6 hunger, stinging you for 1-3 damage. At 10 hunger, your next woodcutting double up triggers twice and eats your equipped apple pie.
abilities.summary: A Woodcutting double up can add 2–6 Hunger and deal 1–3 damage to you. At 10 Hunger, the next Woodcutting double up triggers twice and consumes your equipped Apple Pie.

abilities.name: Spell Echo
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) when a spell hits for its max damage or more, to cast your next spell quickly.
abilities.summary: A spell that deals at least its maximum damage can speed up the next cast.

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to deal 1 additional ranged damage.
abilities.summary: A ranged hit can deal 1 extra damage.

abilities.name: Stoneskin
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to reduce incoming damage by 1
abilities.summary: Can reduce incoming damage by 1.

abilities.name: Sweet Tooth
abilities.description: Fishing double ups have a $curr% chance ($min-$max) to build 2-6 hunger, stinging you for 1-3 damage. At 10 hunger, your next fishing double up triggers twice and eats your equipped redberry pie.
abilities.summary: A Fishing double up can add 2–6 Hunger and deal 1–3 damage to you. At 10 Hunger, the next Fishing double up triggers twice and consumes your equipped Redberry Pie.

abilities.name: Swift Sands
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to travel quickly to your destination.
abilities.summary: Travel can finish faster.

abilities.name: Telegrab Loot
abilities.description: Telegrab the loot when killing an enemy from a safe spot. Requires a Law Rune. $curr% chance (1-60) of not spending the rune
abilities.summary: Retrieves loot from a kill made at a safe spot. You need a Law Rune and have a level-dependent chance to keep it.

abilities.name: Thick Skin
abilities.description: A prayer that increases your defense by 10. Consumes one spirit rune per enemy attack.
abilities.summary: Adds 10 Defense. Uses one Spirit Rune on each enemy attack.

abilities.name: Til Death Do Us Part
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) to block a killing blow aimed at an ally fighting with you.
abilities.summary: Can block a finishing blow aimed at an ally fighting alongside you.

abilities.name: Timber Oracle
abilities.description: $curr% chance ($min-$max) of getting an additional, random log type when chopping trees
abilities.summary: Chopping trees can produce one extra log of a random type.

abilities.name: Tough Arrows
abilities.description: $curr% reduced chance ($min-$max) for your arrows to break.
abilities.summary: Reduces the chance that your arrows break.

abilities.name: Wind Blast
abilities.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit air damage. Casting requires three air runes and a death rune.
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals air damage.

abilities.name: Wind Bolt
abilities.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit air damage. Casting requires two air runes and a chaos rune.
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals air damage.

abilities.name: Wind Strike
abilities.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit air damage. Casting requires an air rune and a mind rune.
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals air damage.

abilities.name: Wind Wave
abilities.description: A spell that deals up to $maxHit air damage. Casting requires seven air runes and a blood rune.
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals air damage.
